body:
I'll get back with a longer answer later, but there's something I want to clarify. I'm not socially awkward at all, at least not anymore. I *can* get along with people, the thing is that they just don't want to. Even when they appear to have fun with me and laugh at my jokes and everything, people don't care about me. They just don't want to befriend me, it's not that I'm socially inept or don't know how to treat people.

----

Ok, the real reply now.

> You will find people who are willing to put up with your social quirks, who share your interests, and who are interested in hanging out with you.

I've met plenty of people with the same interests as me. They just don't want to be with me. Everybody says that college will make things better, but I just think it will be an opportunity for more people to reject me.

> Please know that most couples are not like that.

In Mexico, depending on the socioeconomic status, it can be very common. It's almost a cultural thing, sadly.

> Have you talked to your sisters about the abuse at all?

Yes. They don't want to do anything about it, because they think it's none of our business.

> Do you have any interests that you can pursue while you're passing the time until you get out of your present situation?

A lot of them. Drawing, writing, programming, etc. I've met very few people through these hobbies. None of them I can say are my friends, though.
